title: BTS Face Masks – 5-Pack Party Set: Jimin, V, RM, Suga & J-Hope Card Masks
body:
Our BTS face mask pack puts five members of the K-pop group in one envelope, so you and your friends can turn up to a concert pre-party, a fan meet-up or a themed birthday as the boys themselves. Line up for a group photo and see who guesses who.

BTS Face Mask Pack – 5 Card Masks for K-Pop Fans

Inside are five masks: Jimin, V (Kim Taehyung), RM (Kim Namjoon), Suga (Min Yoongi) and J-Hope (Jung Hoseok). We print every face in full colour on thick 350gsm silk card, cut each one to the shape of the face and cut out the eye holes. Elastic and sticky tabs are supplied for you to attach.

Why you'll love it

  • A ready-made group costume for five K-pop fans, all in one order
  • Thick 350gsm silk card that holds its shape through a whole night of dancing
  • Semi-waterproof finish, so a spilt drink won't spoil the party
  • Eye holes come cut out, so you can still see the stage

Size & details

  • Contents: 5 masks (Jimin, V, RM, Suga and J-Hope)
  • Size: each mask is 297 x 210 mm (A4), a full adult-size face
  • Material: 350gsm silk card, full-colour digital print
  • Fitting: elastic and sticky tabs supplied for you to attach
  • Packaging: posted flat in a board-backed envelope

Delivery

Printed in our UK workshop and posted to you. Dispatch and postage options are shown at checkout.

Just want your favourite? Each mask is sold singly too: Jimin, V, RM, Suga and J-Hope (see all our K-pop face masks).

Please note

This is an unofficial novelty product made for fun and fancy dress. Jimin, V (Kim Taehyung), RM (Kim Namjoon), Suga (Min Yoongi) and J-Hope (Jung Hoseok) have not endorsed, sponsored or approved this product, and Foxy Printing has no connection with them. Their names are used only to describe the design. It is also an unofficial fan design, not endorsed by or connected with BTS, their management or record label.
